description:
## Finding

The proposed deletion is unsafe. The bare agenda drive still admits scheduler jobs that wait on settled facts, especially SeedRoot. When drain arbitration settles a quiesced fact, quiescence_woke_work detects the resulting wake and continues the drive so that job can run. The product driver has a separate movement-based loop, but it does not replace this behavior for Compiler2::drive callers.

## Disproof

A temporary probe aborted whenever the branch would fire. The full library suite reached it in seven scenarios: both return-widening corpus shards 2 and 3, two item-macro splicing tests, multiple test blocks, and passing and failing assert-macro compilation. The run completed with 1579 passed, 7 probe failures, and 5 ignored.

## Resolution

Keep the branch and helper. Remove the temporary probe after recording the result. Any future deletion must first eliminate or migrate the agenda-level settled waiters and prove that Compiler2::drive no longer depends on drain-arbiter wakes. No code tombstone is required; this ticket is the durable record.
title: Keep the live drive-loop arbiter branch
